description: This script processes binary files for firmware or embedded system development. It creates a header with specified addresses and appends it to the input file content to produce an output file, likely used for bootloader or firmware image preparation.

methods.name: auto_int(x)
methods.description: Converts a string to an integer, auto-detecting the base (e.g., hexadecimal).

methods.name: create_header(args, size)
methods.description: Creates a binary header with entry address, load address, and size, packed in big-endian format.

methods.name: create_output(args)
methods.description: Reads input file, creates header, and writes combined header and file content to output file.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main execution function that parses arguments, sets default addresses if needed, and initiates file processing.
